lessons.title: What is Bash? 💡
lessons.description: Understand what a shell is, why Bash rules, and how you’ll talk to your computer.

lessons.title: Your First Terminal Commands ⌨️
lessons.description: Run echo, whoami, pwd, and date. Get comfy with the command line.

lessons.title: Creating Your First Script 📜
lessons.description: Put commands into a file and run it. Hello, world of scripting!

lessons.title: Shebang & Comments ✍️
lessons.description: Learn the #! line that tells the system which interpreter to use. Plus, write helpful comments.

lessons.title: Making Scripts Executable ⚙️
lessons.description: Turn your script into an executable program with chmod and run it from anywhere.
